messages:
Maria: Quick q — product asked if console can send one coalesced notification per-tenant for identical SLO alerts (eg 50 users hitting same error in 1min). Is there an easy backend + SDK contract for that?

Aj: We have a few moving parts: rule evaluation -> alert event stream -> notify router -> delivery. Coalescing can live in notify router as an optional step.

Zach: +1. Need deterministic de-dupe key. Suggest: tenant_id + alert_rule_id + bucket_start_minute. That way different rules or minutes don't collide.

Emily: Agreed on de-dupe key. Also need UI toggle in console per-rule: "Coalesce notifications" with a batching window (30s/1m/5m). UX: default off for canary rollout.

Kevin: Two API concerns: 1) existing frontend SDK expects one event -> one notification. If we start coalescing we need to change webhook payload shape or send an envelope containing events. We should avoid breaking the SDK.

Maria: Good call. Proposal: keep existing payload for single-event deliveries, and introduce an envelope type for batched deliveries, e.g.:

```json
{
  "envelope_type": "coalesced_alerts",
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "bucket_start": "2024-09-22T19:12:00Z",
  "alerts": [ { "rule_id": "r-99", "count": 42, "samples": ["trace://...", "trace://..."] } ]
}
```

Aj: That works. Router can emit either single-alert webhook (unchanged) or envelope. SDKs should detect `envelope_type`. Backwards compatible for older SDKs: they will ignore unknown fields but we can't rely on that for webhooks -> many customers run simple lambda handlers.

Zach: For webhooks we should also add a header `X-Redwood-Coalesced: 1` so simple handlers can short-circuit.

Emily: Console rollout: add an experimental flag behind feature-flag and default to `off` for all tenants. Expose in rule creation UI and in a bulk edit flow. Add telemetry event when coalescing fires: `slo.alert.coalesced` with properties: rule_id, tenant_id, bucket, count.

Kevin: Quotas: coalescing reduces delivery QPS, but increases event aggregation load. Need to add a cost credit for aggregation in quota accounting. Also consider backfill: what happens when router restarts and a bucket wasn't flushed? Prefetch TTL for buckets 2x window.

Maria: Good notes. action items: 1) Aj + Zach: draft router patch that implements envelope support + header (PR). 2) Kevin: update quota model proposal. 3) Emily: wire UI mockups + feature flag. 4) Ops: add `slo.alert.coalesced` telemetry to pipeline.

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline queued: infra/notify-router -> staging (canary) -> prod. ETA staging: 2024-09-25.

Aj: I'll open the PR today. Will include migration plan for SDKs and a sample webhook adapter for customers that want the old behavior.

Zach: For the de-dupe key: also include `severity` or `urgency` mapping so high-priority alerts don't collapse with low-priority ones. Otherwise users miss criticals.

Maria: Yes, keep `urgency` in key. Thanks all — let's sync tomorrow 10am to review PR + console mocks. :thumbsup:
